limitations: Not a multi-connection lock/deadlock stress test.
Payment, wallet, audit and shipping peripheral trigger bodies are neutral fixtures. Reservation status sync uses repository implementation; its production body was not captured.

Original merchandise stock fixture is synthetic; only four supplemental gift stocks were read from production. Differential tests compare original behavior rather than claim current original stock amounts.
No production function installation, production write, or gateway refund was executed.
Automatic inventory release does not execute a financial refund or confirm physical gift return.
